package embeddeddolt_test

import (
	"context"
	"github.com/steveyegge/beads/internal/storage/embeddeddolt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestMu5rOpenClose(t *testing.T) {
	root := os.Getenv("B9S_MEMORY_RESEARCH_ROOT")
	if !strings.HasPrefix(root, "/private/tmp/b9s-mu5r-") {
		t.Fatal("isolated root required")
	}
	dir := filepath.Join(root, "embedded/.beads/embeddeddolt")
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	for sample := 0; sample < 4; sample++ {
		start := time.Now()
		db, closeDB, err := embeddeddolt.OpenSQL(ctx, dir, "beads_graph_91e5e718b4215551f61706a070e5c46b", "main")
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		opened := time.Since(start)
		start = time.Now()
		rows, err := db.QueryContext(ctx, `SELECT v.snapshot FROM graph_preview_catalog c JOIN graph_preview_versions v ON v.path=c.path AND v.version=c.revision WHERE c.allocation_state='live'`)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		n := 0
		for rows.Next() {
			var raw []byte
			if err := rows.Scan(&raw); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			n++
		}
		if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		rows.Close()
		read := time.Since(start)
		start = time.Now()
		if err := closeDB(); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		t.Logf("sample=%d open=%s native_query=%s close=%s generic_records=%d", sample, opened, read, time.Since(start), n)
	}
}

func TestMu5rEmbeddedWriterLock(t *testing.T) {
	root := os.Getenv("B9S_MEMORY_RESEARCH_ROOT")
	if !strings.HasPrefix(root, "/private/tmp/b9s-mu5r-") {
		t.Fatal("isolated root required")
	}
	workspace := filepath.Join(root, "embedded")
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 15*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	_, closeDB, err := embeddeddolt.OpenSQL(ctx, filepath.Join(workspace, ".beads/embeddeddolt"), "beads_graph_91e5e718b4215551f61706a070e5c46b", "main")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer closeDB()
	run := func(timeout time.Duration) ([]byte, error) {
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), timeout)
		defer cancel()
		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, filepath.Join(workspace, ".memory-preview/bin/bd"), "remember", "Concurrent writer probe", "--id", "mu5r-lock-probe", "--title", "Lock probe")
		cmd.Env = []string{"HOME=" + root, "PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin", "BEADS_DOLT_AUTO_START=0", "BEADS_DIR=" + filepath.Join(workspace, ".beads")}
		cmd.Dir = workspace
		cmd.WaitDelay = time.Second
		return cmd.CombinedOutput()
	}
	start := time.Now()
	out, err := run(2 * time.Second)
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatal("writer unexpectedly acquired an open embedded store")
	}
	t.Logf("held-reader writer elapsed=%s err=%v output=%s", time.Since(start), err, out)
	if err := closeDB(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	start = time.Now()
	out, err = run(8 * time.Second)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("writer after release: %v %s", err, out)
	}
	t.Logf("released-reader writer elapsed=%s success=true", time.Since(start))
}
